title: Assault On Japanese Marine Officers

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 21/500-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
S. B. D. 2688/9
Date August 14 - 8 - 31.

Subject (in full) Assault on Japanese marine officers.

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.P.I.

Acting upon the instructions of the Officer i/c Special Branch, I visited Lieutenant-Commander Tomosada, the Staff Officer, at the Headquarters of the Japanese Landing Force, and received from him the following information regarding the assault on two Japanese Marine Officers:-

At 6 p.m. August 10, two Japanese Marine Officers in uniform but unarmed were assaulted by a number of Chinese of the working class while tearing off some Anti-Japanese posters from the walls of the San Yue Industrial Factory, Sung Ka Zeh, off Ward Road, O.O.L. near Yinghsienkong village, with the object of taking them back to their Headquarters. A Chapei policeman arrived on the scene almost immediately and, after driving off the assailants, escorted the officers to No. 4 Substation of the 5th District of the Public Safety Bureau, from where they were allowed to return to their Headquarters. Neither of the two officers suffered any injury.

J. D. S. Umemoto.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Summary of above included in
D.R. of August 14. HR.
File

表格第2号
G. 21/500-1-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案编号。
S. B. D. 2688/9
日期 1931年8月14日。

事由（全称）袭击日本海军陆战队军官事件。

呈报人 J.D.S. Umemoto 转呈人 Henry Robertson C.P.I.

遵照特别课主管官员的指示，我前往日本登陆部队司令部拜访了参谋友定（Tomosada）中佐，并从他那里获得了关于两名日本海军陆战队军官遇袭事件的如下信息：

8月10日下午6时，两名身着制服但未携带武器的日本海军陆战队军官，在华德路（Ward Road）外、引翔港村（Yinghsienkong village）附近的宋家宅（Sung Ka Zeh）三月工业厂（San Yue Industrial Factory）墙壁上撕取一些反日海报，意图将其带回司令部时，遭到一群工人阶级出身的华人袭击。一名闸北警察几乎立即赶到现场，在驱散袭击者后，护送这两名军官前往公安局第五区第四分所，随后他们获准返回司令部。两名军官均未受伤。

J. D. S. Umemoto。

特别课主管官员。

上述摘要已列入
8月14日的日常报告。HR。
归档
1931年8月14日

page_data.en:
D 2693

Assault on Japanese Marine Officers

At 6 p.m. August 10 a number of workers of the
San Yue Industrial Factory, 1 Sung Ka Zah, off Ward Road,
near Yinghsiangkong Village, observed two Japanese
marine officers tear down some Anti-Japanese posters
from the walls of the factory, and assaulted them.
A Chinese policemen arrived on the scene almost
immediately and after driving off the assailants escorted
the two officers to the Japanese Consulate-General.

Officer in charge
The above report was furnished by
an agent of S.I. but Yangtzepoo
know nothing about it. San J. D.S.
Umemoto make inquiries please.
H. Robertson
12/8.

S2,
Please place H.S. Umemoto
at the disposal of SI in
connection with this
investigation.
〔此处为签名〕
12:8:31

J.D.S. Umemoto,
Report to C.O.I. Robertson
for instructions.
J.B.R. 12/8.
page_data.zh:
D 2693

袭击日本海军陆战队军官事件

8月10日下午6时，位于华德路外、引翔港村附近的宋家宅（Sung Ka Zah）1号的三月工业厂（San Yue Industrial Factory）的一些工人，目睹两名日本海军陆战队军官从工厂墙壁上撕下一些反日海报，遂对他们进行了袭击。
一名中国警察几乎立即赶到现场，在驱散袭击者后，将这两名军官护送至日本总领事馆。

主管官员
上述报告由特别情报处（S.I.）的一名线人提供，但杨树浦（Yangtzepoo）方面对此一无所知。请 J.D.S. Umemoto 进行查询。
H. Robertson
8月12日。

S2，
请将 H.S. Umemoto 交由特别情报处（SI）支配，以协助此项调查。
〔此处为签名〕
1931年8月12日

J.D.S. Umemoto，
向 C.O.I. Robertson 报告以请示指令。
J.B.R. 8月12日。
